summary: Camera behaviour of the editor (free) camera; seen on camera entities in every level and in dialogues. The member boundaries come from the Toolkit's move-assignment operator, which copies member by member: 4@0, 1@4, 1@5, 1@6, 4@8, 4@0xC, 4@0x10, 1@0x14, 4@0x18, 8@0x1C, 8@0x24, 4@0x2C, 8@0x30, 4@0x38, 4@0x3C (bytes 7 and 0x15-0x17 are not copied = padding). Defaults from the macOS constructor (offsets agree with operator=). Registration bg3.exe+0x3B5CE40: size/alignment word 0x400040 (size 0x40), no destructor.
